differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned at a lower, more oblique angle, creating stronger perspective distortion on the yellow button.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned at a higher, more top-down angle, showing more surrounding tiles with less perspective.
differences.fix: Lower the camera height and increase pitch to match the oblique perspective.

differences.a_observable: The yellow button has a glossy finish with a distinct highlight on its top edge, and sits in a textured brushed-metal recess.
differences.b_observable: The yellow button has a flat matte finish, and the recess is a plain grey color without texture.
differences.fix: Apply a glossy material to the yellow button and a brushed-metal texture to the recess.

differences.a_observable: The white background tiles are warm-toned with high contrast against the dark recesses.
differences.b_observable: The white background tiles have a cooler, blue-grey cast with lower overall contrast.
differences.fix: Adjust the color grading to warm up the whites and increase contrast.
